title: Future Horizons: Global Metaphors on Hungarian Soil
grammar: Metaphoric Evolution, Linguistic Innovation, and the Global Horizon
goal: I can explain how new digital words fit into Hungarian with existing endings and preverbs.
I can use words such as nyelvi megújulás and digitális tér.
I can say in simple terms that a language changes with the world.
